title: A Cake Film by the Sea
paras: Every spring, Mara makes a short film for a bakery on a small [[island|island]]. The film shows how its special [[easter|Easter]] cake is made. First, she moves some [[furniture|furniture]] away from the kitchen window. This gives her space for a camera and lets more light reach the work table. She puts the camera near the baker's hands, then presses a red [[button|button]] to start recording.

The baker, Tomas, cuts a round cake into two layers. He spreads thick [[cream|cream]] between them and puts a pink sugar [[rose|rose]] on top. The flower looks real, but people can eat it. Mara films each step twice. She is [[worried|worried]] that her camera may miss something important. Tomas is especially [[careful|careful]] when he lifts the soft flower with a small knife. Its thin edges can break easily.

Later, Mara joins the best parts of the film on her computer. She adds short instructions below the pictures. One says the cake takes ten minutes to bake. That is [[false|false]], so she changes it to thirty minutes after checking with Tomas. The finished film has an [[unusual|unusual]] ending: a close view of the sugar flower, followed by Tomas cutting it in half. Now viewers can see that every part is ready to eat.
zh: 每年春天，玛拉都会为一座小岛上的面包店制作一部短片。短片展示店里的特色复活节蛋糕是怎样做成的。首先，她把厨房窗边的几件家具搬开。这样既能腾出放摄像机的位置，也能让更多光线照到操作台上。她把摄像机放在靠近面包师双手的地方，然后按下红色按钮，开始拍摄。
面包师托马斯把一个圆蛋糕横切成两层。他在两层之间抹上浓稠的奶油，再在顶上放一朵粉色的糖玫瑰。这朵花看起来像真的，但可以吃。玛拉把每个步骤都拍两遍。她担心摄像机会漏掉重要的细节。托马斯用一把小刀托起柔软的糖花时格外小心，因为它薄薄的边缘很容易碎。
随后，玛拉在电脑上把拍得最好的片段接在一起，并在画面下方加上简短的操作说明。其中一条写着蛋糕需要烤十分钟。这是不对的，所以她向托马斯核实后，把时间改成了三十分钟。完成后的短片有个与众不同的结尾：先给糖花一个特写，接着拍托马斯把它切成两半。现在，观众可以看出，蛋糕的每一部分都可以吃了。

q.s: The bakery owns the camera Mara uses.
q.why: 文章未说明拍摄用的摄像机归谁所有。

q.s: Mara films each step two times.
q.why: 第二段明确说每个步骤都拍两遍。

q.s: After checking with Tomas, Mara changes the baking time to ten minutes.
q.why: 核实后她把十分钟改成了三十分钟。
